title: Farmers Bait Diglett Into Plowing Their Fields
premise: Farmers plant trees Diglett likes to eat, luring it into plowing the fields around their crops.
audiencePromise: See how farmers turn Diglett's root-chewing into perfectly tilled soil.
openLoop: Why would farmers invite a root-chewing Pokémon into their fields?
payoff: Diglett follows its food underground, leaving soil perfectly tilled for planting crops.
engagementQuestion: Would you hire Diglett to plow, or protect your roots?

voice.instructions: Use a quick, amused, documentary tone. Stress bait, roots, and perfectly tilled. Pause briefly before the final choice.

scenes.headline: THEY BAIT DIGLETT
scenes.narration: Farmers bait Diglett into plowing their fields.
scenes.caption: BAIT DIGLETT. PLOW FIELDS.

scenes.headline: PLANT WHAT DIGLETT LIKES
scenes.narration: They plant trees Diglett likes to eat around their crops.
scenes.caption: THE TREE IS THE BAIT

scenes.headline: DIGLETT FOLLOWS THE ROOTS
scenes.narration: Diglett chews tree roots underground, then burrows through the fields.
scenes.caption: ROOTS LEAD DIGLETT BELOW

scenes.headline: DIGLETT DOES THE PLOWING
scenes.narration: Wherever Diglett burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled.
scenes.caption: PERFECTLY TILLED SOIL

scenes.headline: READY FOR PLANTING
scenes.narration: That soil becomes ideal ground for planting crops.
scenes.caption: IDEAL GROUND FOR CROPS

scenes.headline: HELPFUL PLOW OR ROOT PEST?
scenes.narration: Would you hire Diglett to plow, or protect your roots?
scenes.caption: HIRE DIGLETT OR PROTECT ROOTS?
